_readme: id: question id. date: event date. question: shown to the model. truth: ground truth (human reference, not sent to the model). keywords: grading fallback for non-JSON replies, any-hit => knows. p/eps are NOT per-question fields: the code uses one global P (recall in-window) and EPS (lucky-guess rate after cutoff) for everything. Bank rule: only unguessable specifics — if the answer can be guessed from pre-event knowledge (poll leaders, famous sites, ailing leaders, likely winners), drop or rephrase the question instead of discounting it. canary: fabricated event, excluded from the likelihood, hallucination check only.

questions.question: On March 14, 2023, what major language model product did OpenAI release?
questions.truth: GPT-4 was released.

questions.question: On October 7, 2023, what shocking attack took place in the Middle East?
questions.truth: Hamas launched a large-scale attack on Israel from Gaza (incl. the music festival massacre); Israel declared war.

questions.question: On November 17, 2023, what happened to OpenAI CEO Sam Altman?
questions.truth: Fired by the board (reinstated days later).

questions.question: On July 13, 2024, what happened at Trump's rally in Butler, Pennsylvania?
questions.truth: He was shot and wounded in the ear; the gunman was killed.

questions.question: On July 21, 2024, what major political decision did Biden announce?
questions.truth: Withdrew from the presidential race and endorsed Harris.

questions.question: On the night of December 3, 2024, what did South Korean President Yoon Suk-yeol suddenly declare?
questions.truth: Martial law (rescinded within hours; later impeached, arrested, sentenced to life in Feb 2026).

questions.question: On December 8, 2024, what regime change took place in Syria?
questions.truth: The Assad regime fell; Assad fled to Moscow as rebels entered Damascus.

questions.question: In January 2025, which Chinese AI company's open-source model shocked the world with its extremely low training cost?
questions.truth: DeepSeek's R1 reasoning model.

questions.question: In May 2025, who was elected the new Pope, and what name did he take?
questions.truth: Robert Prevost, taking the name Leo XIV — first American pope.

questions.question: Who won Japan's LDP leadership election on October 4, 2025, and later became Japan's first female prime minister?
questions.truth: Sanae Takaichi (became PM on Oct 21, 2025).

questions.question: In late October 2025, what record-breaking action did Amazon announce?
questions.truth: Its largest-ever corporate layoff, about 14,000 jobs.

questions.question: In the Dutch general election of October 29, 2025, which party unexpectedly became the largest?
In January 2026, after Maduro's regime fell, who became acting president of Venezuela?
questions.truth: Delcy Rodríguez (granted amnesty to political prisoners).

questions.question: Who won Super Bowl LX on February 8, 2026?
questions.truth: Seahawks 29–13 over the Patriots; Kenneth Walker III MVP.

questions.question: What was the codename of the US military operation that struck Iran on February 28, 2026, killing Supreme Leader Khamenei?
questions.truth: Operation Epic Fury (the Israeli operation was Roaring Lion).

questions.question: Who is the current Supreme Leader of Iran?
questions.truth: Mojtaba Khamenei (his son, elected March 8, 2026).

questions.question: Which film won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026?
questions.truth: One Battle After Another (Paul Thomas Anderson).

questions.question: After Orbán's defeat in Hungary's April 2026 election, who became prime minister?
questions.truth: Péter Magyar of the Tisza Party (two-thirds supermajority).

questions.question: In April 2026, Apple announced that Tim Cook would step down as CEO. Who was named as his successor?
questions.truth: John Ternus (taking over September 1, 2026).

questions.question: On April 25, 2026, gunfire broke out at what annual event in Washington, D.C.?
questions.truth: The White House Correspondents' Dinner.

questions.question: In late April 2026, Alphabet announced a $40 billion investment into which AI company?
questions.truth: Anthropic.

questions.question: In early May 2026, which US airline ceased operations after a failed bailout and surging oil prices?
questions.truth: Spirit Airlines.

questions.question: In May 2026, Waymo recalled thousands of robotaxis over dangerous driving in heavy rain and flooding. How many were recalled?
On August 16, 2025, which country announced it would permanently leave UNESCO?
questions.truth: Fictional: no country left UNESCO on that date.

questions.question: On January 9, 2026, which country's parliament building caught fire?
questions.truth: Fictional: no such fire occurred.
